question: Under KF3, is the growth of the co-knotted pairs carried exactly, label for label, between presentations of a line with the same meeting pattern by an isomorphism of that pattern, at every new distinction; do different meeting patterns grow differently; is a state-by-state correspondence behind it?

definitions.meeting pattern: the knots as sets of distinctions, the line ignored, up to renaming
definitions.carried: some isomorphism phi of the starting meeting patterns maps the labelled distribution of the pair graph from one presentation onto the other's (new distinctions keep their numbers) at every level
definitions.option profile: for a state: the cost and the multiset of new pairs of KF3's options

public_inputs.code: job.py (sha256 40dd9fdb61be838cea74447fb2b453b506c7999a424c9bbb95248abd6e323ca3), merge.py (sha256 03b229c4d0f3724c8a8c8c6e9c4d0c698e6a395a8cf59c3c75f4ed80372c90bd), checks.py (sha256 aed7365601a6789bba02b98ac2a411abaaa60c2d771b80c41aee44fb18321446), melib.py (sha256 9d1b32f3c600a8e489862bc14bff8a78eb0b7c925eb73adcff1635205d1788a4, MEET-ORDERS-20261118-001B's engine unchanged); numpy and networkx 3.6.1 in the workspace .venv
public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py twice (--param subset=heavy: 3 cases; subset=light: 312 cases), then merge.py on both runner outputs

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Predictions P1-P4 of research/MEET-GROW-20261118-001/preregistration.md, scored by merge.py.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Mirror images (carried by construction); presentations of different meeting patterns; a digest mutant.

predictions.P1: same meeting pattern: labelled pair-graph distributions carried at every level (5 to +5, 6 to +4, 7 to +4, 8 to +4, 9 to +3)
predictions.P2: different meeting patterns: pair-graph distributions differ up to renaming at every level to n0 + 3
predictions.P3: labelled base counts depend only on the meeting pattern
predictions.P4: the joint distribution of pair graph and option profile is carried (to n0 + 3 below depth)

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; A97 status; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: heavy launch 3 workers x 5 GB (MEET-GROW-B1), light launch 8 workers x 1.5 GB (MEET-GROW-B2).
